card.title: Lost in the Process
card.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The birthday invitations failed during address verification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The archive supplied an outdated location.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which suggests we've identified a staffing problem, not an individual error.

mechanism: A disguises personally addressing invitations incorrectly as an archive and staffing failure.
confusable: Unlike blaming an identifiable coworker, A must spread or reclassify blame through impersonal process language.
comparison: An archive identity challenge becomes a system-capacity issue, distinct from the parcel scene's departmental multiplication.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
